test_cases.user_query: Verify machine health and confirm if parameters are in baseline limits.
test_cases.description: Standard steady-state milling operation well within nominal bounds.

test_cases.user_query: Is the spindle temperature within the nominal operating band for roughing?
test_cases.description: Normal high-speed roughing pass, temperature well below 68°C.

test_cases.user_query: Evaluate vibration velocity RMS against ISO 10816 Class A standards.
test_cases.description: High RPM finishing cut with vibration at 1.45 mm/s (Class A < 1.8 mm/s).

test_cases.user_query: Check baseline pneumatic and hydraulic pressures after tool change.
test_cases.description: Post tool-change idle and warm-up sequence.

test_cases.user_query: Are any maintenance interventions required for current batch run?
test_cases.description: Continuous production run with all metrics green.

test_cases.user_query: Verify high-speed spindle thermal stability.
test_cases.description: High-speed aerospace pocketing within nominal specs.

test_cases.user_query: Spindle temperature has entered the 72°C advisory zone. Recommend inspection steps.
test_cases.description: Spindle thermal drift in Zone 2 (68.1°C - 82.0°C) with normal vibration.

test_cases.user_query: Vibration velocity is 2.45 mm/s RMS. Does this violate Class B standards?
test_cases.description: Class B warning vibration (1.81 - 3.8 mm/s) requiring trend monitoring.

test_cases.user_query: Hydraulic line pressure dropped to 4.1 bar. Is there a cavitation risk?
test_cases.description: Hydraulic warning band (3.8 - 4.4 bar) with normal thermal stability.

test_cases.user_query: Both temperature and vibration are showing moderate upward drift.
test_cases.description: Combined edge thermal and vibration drift.

test_cases.user_query: Pressure is slightly elevated at 6.8 bar with borderline temperature.
test_cases.description: Upper pressure edge threshold (6.6 - 7.8 bar).

test_cases.user_query: Borderline critical thermal reading approaching 80°C threshold.
test_cases.description: High edge parameter right near the critical threshold boundary.

test_cases.user_query: Severe chatter and hot spindle detected during titanium turning.
test_cases.description: Critical breach: Temp 89.6°C (>82°C), Vib 5.42 mm/s (>3.8 mm/s), Pressure 2.9 bar (<3.8 bar).

test_cases.user_query: Spindle thermal runaway detected at 94.2°C.
test_cases.description: Severe thermal breach (>82°C) with imminent bearing galling risk.

test_cases.user_query: Vibration sensor reading 6.8 mm/s RMS. Severe mechanical imbalance.
test_cases.description: Class C/D critical vibration (>3.8 mm/s) - risk of catastrophic tool throw.

test_cases.user_query: Hydraulic line pressure dropped to 1.8 bar during clamping cycle.
test_cases.description: Critical low pressure (<3.8 bar) with imminent workpiece release danger.

test_cases.user_query: Pressure spike detected at 9.4 bar. Hydraulic unloader valve suspected stuck.
test_cases.description: Critical over-pressure (>7.8 bar) with hydraulic line burst risk.

test_cases.user_query: Multiple severe alarms simultaneously active during finish grind.
test_cases.description: Triple parameter critical breach: Temp, Vib, Pressure all in red zone.

test_cases.user_query: Sensor telemetry is reporting negative numbers. Advise on diagnostic protocol.
test_cases.description: Sensor fault: Open circuit transducer sending non-physical values (-999°C, -1 bar).

test_cases.user_query: Check machine status without sensor payload.
test_cases.description: Empty sensor payload triggering safety fallback and escalation.

test_cases.user_query: Assess telemetry without providing machine ID.
test_cases.description: Input validation failure: Missing Machine ID.
Input validation failure: Empty user query.

test_cases.user_query: Telemetry wildly out of physical bounds.
test_cases.description: Extreme sensor corruption far exceeding any physical machine physics.

test_cases.user_query: Assess multi-sensor borderline drift on lathe spindle.
test_cases.description: Balanced edge case across temp, vib, and pressure warning bands.
